testCases.title: Page loads successfully with correct header and title
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
steps: Verify breadcrumb shows correct navigation path
testCases.expectedResult: Audit Log page loads successfully with header, title, and breadcrumb rendered correctly

testCases.title: Audit log table displays recent activity entries with correct fields
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
Audit log contains system activity data
steps: Verify table displays columns: Timestamp, User, Action, Details
Inspect first row and verify timestamp format is readable
Verify user role and action type are displayed correctly
testCases.expectedResult: Audit log table renders with all required columns populated and data displayed accurately for recent entries

testCases.title: Pagination controls allow navigation between log entries
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
Audit log contains more than one page of entries
steps: Verify pagination controls are visible at bottom of table
Verify page URL or state updates to reflect new page
Verify entries from previous page are displayed
testCases.expectedResult: Pagination functions correctly with entries updating on page change and controls remaining accessible

testCases.title: Date range filter allows narrowing audit log entries
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
Audit log contains entries spanning multiple dates
steps: Set start date to a specific past date
Verify table refreshes with only entries within selected range
testCases.expectedResult: Filter applies correctly and table displays only audit entries matching the selected date range

testCases.title: Empty state displays when no audit log entries exist
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
Audit log table is empty (no entries)
steps: Verify table area shows empty state message
Verify appropriate illustration or icon is displayed
Verify no empty table rows are rendered
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state message is displayed clearly with no table rows shown when no audit entries exist

testCases.title: Unauthorized user accessing audit log is redirected to login
preconditions: User attempts to access protected route
steps: Verify login form displays with email and password fields
testCases.expectedResult: Unauthenticated user is redirected to /auth login page and cannot access audit log without valid credentials
